description: Managed issue-label taxonomy. Existing unrelated labels remain untouched. Synchronization targets only listed roadmap issues.

labels.name: kind:tracking
labels.description: Umbrella issue / roadmap coordination rather than an implementation task

labels.name: kind:feature
labels.description: New functionality or supported workload

labels.name: kind:bug
labels.description: Fix incorrect behavior or a defect

labels.name: kind:validation
labels.description: Testing, benchmarking, qualification and release evidence

labels.name: kind:maintenance
labels.description: CI, installers, dependencies and general upkeep

labels.name: kind:refactor
labels.description: Internal restructuring without intended feature changes

labels.name: kind:documentation
labels.description: Documentation, translations and onboarding

labels.name: area:backends
labels.description: Inference backends and container/runtime adapters

labels.name: area:telemetry
labels.description: CPU/GPU telemetry, power and resource measurements

labels.name: area:benchmark
labels.description: Load generation, workload execution, metrics and statistics

labels.name: area:reporting
labels.description: HTML/PDF/CSV/JSON reports, comparison and export

labels.name: area:platform
labels.description: CLI, launchers, setup, CI and cross-platform compatibility

labels.name: area:multimodal
labels.description: Speech, image, vision and non-text AI tasks

labels.name: area:datasets
labels.description: Dataset manifests, fixtures, licenses and integrity

labels.name: priority:p0
labels.description: Release blocker: correctness, critical cleanup or required qualification

labels.name: priority:p1
labels.description: High priority for its target release

labels.name: priority:p2
labels.description: Normal priority; does not block immediate stabilization
